title: Olist Analytics Engineering (dbt + DuckDB)
description: Modelled 10 raw e-commerce and marketing tables into tested dbt marts (24 models, 80 tests, CI on every push), then built a Power BI dashboard and a lead-scoring model. Found that only 3% of customers reorder, that untracked lead sources close best at 16.6%, and that scoring leads on arrival lifts the top 10% to a 23% close rate against a 10.5% average.
